name: HUNT
summary: An IHEP-led proposal for an exceptionally large underwater neutrino telescope is developing sensors and prototype arrays in the South China Sea and Lake Baikal.
physics_targets: High-energy Galactic and extragalactic neutrino point sources
detection_principle: Widely distributed optical modules would reconstruct Cherenkov emission from high-energy neutrino interactions. Deep-water tests validate deployment, photodetection and acquisition before scaling up.

sites.name: International project proposed by a Chinese team; tests in Lake Baikal and the South China Sea

status.label: Research and development
status.evidence: IHEP lists HUNT under construction and pre-research, with prototype work rather than an operating 30 km³ array.

timeline.event: Sensor R&D and deep-water prototype campaigns.
IHEP described construction of a small South China Sea prototype array.

results.summary: Multiple deep-water tests demonstrated engineering progress. Projected source yields are forecasts, not observed neutrino-source discoveries.
